title: The God Who Sees Me
themeTags: God meets us in the hard place
reflectionQuestion: Hagar felt all alone in the desert — but God saw her, and heard her, and gave her just what she needed. When you feel lonely, who helps you remember that God sees you too?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Hagar, Genesis 21:8-21). Mood=hurting (thin). FEELING-FIRST: alone, forgotten. Despair handled LIGHTLY (Adam) -- no dwelling on the dying; focus on God hearing + the well. Image: the WELL. Ends ON the well image (Adam): 'God helps us see the well that was there all along' (Gen 21 = God opens her eyes to a well that is there, NOT 'prepared it beforehand'). The Gen-16 naming ('God who sees me') removed from the body; title keeps it. SHORT+FULL only (Adam: don't stretch). Voice TBC (proposed VOICE_ARABELLA).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.
